xmldoc.short_description: Generate all combinations of categorical values.

param_input_item.param_description: Input arrays. Each input is converted to a column before the combinations are formed.

param_output_item.param_description: Table containing one row for each combination of input elements.

description.p: combinations forms a table containing the Cartesian product of the supplied arrays.
When an input variable has a name, that name is reused as the corresponding table variable name.

example_item.example_item_data: A = categorical({'small','large'}); B = categorical({'red','blue'}); T = combinations(A, B)
